'''Lucas Bartmoss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] in the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]].

{{RPG|''[[Ultimate Core Dump]]''}}
Sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents [[Mission to Tazan|traveled]] to Tazan and they persuaded Bartmoss to let them inside the Data Processing Facility.
{{Endgame}}
